entries.label: P: “Aleksandra Bulajić is a 3D Artist within our game developme…”
entries.value: Aleksandra Bulajić is a 3D Artist within our game development team, specializing in 3D game art, environment design, and asset creation for mobile game development. With a strong foundation in art fundamentals and a practical understanding of production constraints, she focuses on clarity, clean silhouettes, and cohesive visual storytelling.

entries.label: P: “Her work balances artistic intention with technical efficie…”
entries.value: Her work balances artistic intention with technical efficiency, ensuring that assets not only look polished but perform well within real-time game environments. Simplicity, consistency, and immersion define her approach to game art design.
